plugins.name: mentor
plugins.description: A lean planning harness for Claude Code: a marker-driven edit gate keeps the repo read-only until a Mermaid-first Markdown plan — checked against a per-repo constitution and a pre-approval light review — is approved.

plugins.name: sdlc-mini
plugins.description: Turbo SDLC helpers: a release-notes generator and a tidy commit helper. Manifest and env-config setup have moved to the devflow plugin; init-turbo-manifest and init-turbo-env-config remain as deprecated redirects.

plugins.name: loom
plugins.description: Session harvesting and plugin lifecycle tools: harvest a session into reusable Claude Code artifacts or a new marketplace plugin, tune (audit/enhance) an existing plugin from a real session, and publish releases with synced manifests.
